title: Candlelit portrait
prompt_en: 21:9 close-up. An old man's face lit only by a candle, flame flickering, he slowly looks up from a book toward the camera. Deep shadows, warm amber tones, Rembrandt lighting, shallow depth of field.
prompt_zh: 21:9 特写。老人的脸只被烛光照亮，火焰摇曳，他从书上缓缓抬头看向镜头。深沉阴影，暖琥珀色调，伦勃朗光，浅景深。
why_it_works: Naming a known lighting style (Rembrandt) gives a compact, widely understood instruction.
